Get Tryout Updates Row New York is proud to be an official charity partner for the NYRR 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon on Sunday, March 15, 2026, and we’re actively recruiting runners to join our team. By running for Row New York, you’ll turn every mile into meaningful impact, supporting Row New York’s free and low-cost programs serving youth, Veterans, and students with disabilities across New York City. Our youth program provides far more than competitive rowing opportunities—offering intensive academic support, college preparation, career readiness, mental health counseling, mentorship, transportation, snacks, and more—so young people can thrive both on and off the water. Become a Charity Runner Interested in running for Row New York and supporting our mission with your miles? Complete the Interest Form to be considered for a charity bib. Charity Runner Details 🏃 Race Date: March 15, 2026 at 7:00 AM🎟️ Charity Bibs Available: 10💙 Fundraising Minimum: $2,500 Charity runner spots are limited and tend to fill quickly.
